frame_selection: Amplitude a=1; common1s; or geometric midpoint of each public tau support. No fitted/truth timescale.
source_selection: Same saved8/32-record populations and frozen construction/heldout split as baseline. No new inference or truth reads.
conditional_model: Full linear dependence on every preceding coordinate, scalar Gaussian residual, exact dependent-support normalizer. Moment projection then support correction; not truncated MLE.
probe_semantics: Rest/load last the stated horizon; reversal has one such positive segment followed by one negative segment. Constant segments split into intervals<=1s. Health stationary; preserve physical state and invalid mass.
numerics: Reuse qualified bounded transforms,52-step OCV inverse,erfc/scaled normalizer and128-round exact rejection sampler; density batches512. Inherit capacity placement16passes and quadratic128/256 quadrature.
controls: Full16 inverse and Jacobian for all frames
Linear conditional cross terms and chain normalization
Prior controls and unchanged source identities
assessment: All16 moments, heldout physical-coordinate density, SOC/Q/R0 marginals, prediction mean/SD/quantiles across all horizons, support-correction mass, packed bytes, full offline memory lower bound and CPU. No new physical or NLL threshold.
baseline_extension: Regenerate each saved voltage-coordinate population with its original seed and score new probes; do not refit. Include pooled heldout and per-population predictions. This control work is included in predictive-step cap.
failure_policy: Qualify before cases; preserve each unavailable case and continue census. No tuning after heldout results.
limits: Short offline snapshot study, not long-term learning
Reused finite-moment reference, not new independent coverage validation
No complete MCU memory or speed claim
